decisive_items: clearly demarcated from the uterus and bladder, displacing the uterus to the right superior-lateral side
a separate 126 × 106 mm homogeneous solid mass in the left adnexa with a clear border
145 × 110 × 146 mm multilocular cystic mass with thick septa and enhancing solid components
response.rationale: CT shows a pelvic mass clearly separate from the uterus, consistent with an ovarian origin; the left adnexal solid mass on ultrasound supports an ovarian fibroma. R3 (myoma) is less likely given the clear demarcation from the uterus, and R1 (infected hematometra) is a secondary finding rather than the primary mass.

rejected.why: Isolated uterine cavity finding, not the dominant pelvic mass.
Mass is separate from uterus, making leiomyoma unlikely.
